structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. The page only names kinds of saving, with no interest rates and nothing about bank fees. The only thing that sounded as safe as my deposit was אג"ח ממשלתיות, so I'll ask my son or the bank clerk about that.

stuck.why: The three starting points are קרן השתלמות, a pension and קרן כספית. None of them fits a retiree with deposits, and I don't know the word קרן כספית
It fills up with מדד MSCI, S&P 500 and נאסד"ק. English letters and 'מדד' in a sense I don't know. I felt it wasn't for me and stopped reading
'איפה הכסף מוחזק' versus 'במה הכסף מושקע' is abstract. I read it twice
